notes.title: Big Update Delayed Because of Silksong
notes.content:
Dear friends! As you know, I’ve been working on a new hardcore mode for the game. There will be new achievements tied to this mode, and new opportunities to die painful deaths across the Ark! Just the way we love it!

On top of that, I’ve made some adjustments to the regular content as well. For example, players really enjoyed searching for Cats, but many were frustrated that some Cats could be missed forever unless you started a new game. Well, that’s been fixed! Now you’ll be able to find all the Cats and unlock every ending in a single playthrough!

My original plan was to release the big update and set up a major discount at the beginning of September. BUT! Silksong is coming out. Which means that in the near future, all Metroidvania fans will be busy with it.

I don’t see any point in releasing exciting new content into the void, so I’ve decided to postpone the new version by one month.

So - the hardcore mode, new achievements, and the content patch will launch on October 6th!

Thank you for your understanding!

notes.title: Quest fixes, new achievement
notes.content:
Now you can't accidentally skip the quest with the recipe book.
 Removed the ability to skip the battle with the secret boss.
 Added a new achievement.
 Optimized memory cleaning, now there will be no short FPS drops during the battle.

notes.title: QTE optimization patch
notes.content: Optimized scenes of combat rituals. This significantly reduces the load on the video card during QTE.

notes.title: Character physics fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where Shaman would twitch and bounce when hitting the ground at low fps

notes.title: Optimization patch
notes.content:
Optimization of 3D objects: added reduction in rendering quality at a large distance.
 Fixed several bugs.
 Added the ability to skip both cutscenes at the beginning of the game (but I do not recommend you do this, there is a plot!)

notes.title: Bug fixes and gameplay experience improvements
notes.content:
- Fixed several typos in the text
- Fixed textures in trance
- Fixed flies on the Fly Giver boss
- Foundation for NG+ mode (it's in development, it's not in the game yet!)

notes.title: The final version of the demo is out
A free demo version of the game is available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear friends! I'm happy to announce that the free demo of Shaman's Ark is now available on Steam! It will be available until the end of the Next fest (Oct 14 - Oct 21). Therefore, I invite you to explore the lands of the Ark! In the demo version you will find:

 5 large story locations
 2 initial bosses of the game
 several useful acquaintances with the inhabitants of the Ark

Welcome to the Ark!
